name: Grapple Gaia -Joou no Wing Crown-
original_name: グラップルガイア -女王の翼冠-
source:
33rd century. Humanity has expanded its control to 20% of the galaxy. Mother Earth's memory had already become hazy, but she had left her mark on a martial art that was popular throughout the universe. That is "Grapple Gaia". The people were enthusiastic about the feast of grapplers colliding with each other to the best of their ability. The grapple world was abuzz when Queen Silvana, who stood at the top of the group, suddenly announced her return and announced a tournament to stake her treasure, the Wing Crown. The main character, a young trainer, is one of them. She establishes a new organization and aims to reach the top of grapple with her partner... A card battle adventure game based on martial arts.

Only sold at Comiket 66 and through limited Gainax mail order.
